fields.title: Where to collect data
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each screen, state where to collect: client, server, shared resource.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Home screen, 5 sources, changes once a year, peak load
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Profile settings screen, 3 sources, changes monthly
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — server, endpoint tailored to the screen: load is heavy, screen is stable. 2 — client from shared resources: changes frequently, load is low. 3 — shared resources: partner scenarios are unknown to us. 4 — client: experiment should not require a server release for every tweak. Criterion: what changes more often — the screen or the load on it.
